slides.sub: Less common than the hype suggests.

slides.body: Gaja-Kesari Yoga (the 'elephant-and-lion' combination) forms when Jupiter sits in a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house) from the Moon. That is 4 of 12 positions, so roughly one chart in three technically qualifies.
Classical texts expect more than geometry. A yoga that delivers needs both planets reasonably strong, not combust, not debilitated, and well placed.

points: Is the Moon strong and not heavily afflicted?
Is Jupiter strong in sign and house?
Does a malefic spoil either planet?
Do the dashas of these planets ever run?

slides.body: No yoga guarantees fame, success or wealth. A strong one is a supportive factor that still needs effort, timing and the rest of the chart.
